description: Connect your MimartLabs account to create and edit architectural projects through ChatGPT. Build rooms, walls, doors, windows, roofs and stairs; inspect geometry and model validation; change surface materials; and work with CAD drawings, layers and dimensions. Generate floor plans, sections and elevations, arrange drawing sheets, export DXF and reopen saved results in the Mimart editor. The connection operates on projects your account can access.

defaultPrompt: Create a new project with a 4 × 5 metre room, one door and two windows. Give me the editor link to review it.
List my projects and help me choose one. Summarize its floors and rooms, calculate quantities, and check for modeling issues.
Create a 4 × 3 metre rectangular CAD outline, add dimensions, and organize the geometry and dimensions on separate layers.
